name: Wuxi ETEK Microelectronics Co.,Ltd.
summary: Wuxi ETEK Micro-Electronics Co.,Ltd., founded in 2002 and based in Wuxi, China, specializes in the production of analog integrated circuits (ICs). The company offers a comprehensive array of IC solutions, including: Power management ICs: Such as LDO and DC-DC converters, voltage monitors, lithium-ion battery chargers, and various protective switches like ESD/EOS, over-voltage protection (OVP), load, and current limit switches. Signal and sensing ICs: Encompassing analog switches, level shifters, I/O expanders, Power Delivery (PD) controllers, audio ICs, and Hall effect switches. Display and LED drivers: Including components for "fun" LEDs, LED and LCD matrix displays, and flash LED applications. Other specialized ICs: Such as e-detonator network ICs, infrared (IR) controllers, and general-purpose logic ICs. These diverse components are integral to a wide range of applications, including wireless charging interfaces, linear chargers with integrated power path management, advanced Type-C mix switches, PD controllers, high-performance 3A dual-rail LDOs, and various load switch designs.
